title: A Cipher for the Debt
author: Tamsin Dunmore
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
